The outer rim: on closer collaboration between Eastern Europe and East Asia
snippet: At first glance, the regions of Eastern Europe and East Asia appear to have little in common due to their geographic distance. Despite this, existing connections between the two regions have the potential to act as the foundations for a stronger relationship based on shared values and concerns.
